transcript.content: Hello, I’m glad you came in. What brings you in today?

I guess... well, I'm having some trouble with my work. I keep turning in things—like applications or notes for my research—with these stupid mistakes. Like I'll put the wrong date on an artwork, or just completely skip a question. And the thing is, I really thought I checked them. It's just getting embarrassing, so... yeah, that's why I'm here.
Were you having these kinds of attention or careless mistakes as a child?

Yeah... I guess so. Um, even back in elementary school, my teachers used to write that I had good ideas, but... I'd forget to turn worksheets in, or I'd lose the instructions. Just missing little details, I guess. My parents basically had to check my backpack every night just to make sure I actually did everything.
Do you often feel nervous or on edge?
Um... no. Not really. I don't think I feel like that.
Before age 12, were these attention or careless-mistake problems already happening at home or in school?
Um... yeah. I mean, like I just said about elementary school... that was before I was twelve. So... yeah. Both, I guess.
Do you often feel restless or fidgety?
Um... no, not really. I don't think so.
Do these attention or careless-mistake problems also happen at home?
Um... I don't really know. I haven't really thought about it happening at home.
Do these kinds of attention or careless-mistake problems happen in more than one place, like both at work or school and at home?
Um... I mean, I guess so. Like I said, definitely at school. But... I don't really know about home. I just haven't noticed it much there, I suppose.
Do these attention or careless-mistake problems happen at home too?
Uh... didn't you just ask me that? Like I said... I really don't know. I just don't really notice it when I'm there.
Do these attention or careless-mistake problems also happen in places other than work or school, like at home?
I... I don't really know what else to tell you. It's the same answer. I just... I don't think so. I only really notice it at school.
Do these attention or careless-mistake problems also happen at home?
Look, I... I really don't know why you keep asking me the exact same thing. My answer hasn't changed. I just don't notice it there.
Do you have these same attention or careless-mistake problems in more than one setting, such as at work or school and also at home?
I just... I feel like we're going in circles here. I don't know what else to say. It's just a problem at school. I don't really pay attention to that stuff anywhere else.
Do you have these same trouble-with-details problems at home too?
I... no. Like I just said... I don't notice it at home. Just school. I really don't have a different answer for you.
Do you have trouble paying attention or making careless mistakes in everyday non-school tasks, like at home chores or managing personal errands?
I... I really don't know how many different ways I can answer this. No. Not with chores or errands. Just school.
